findings.rationale: The security group allows unrestricted ingress for TCP port 22, exposing administrative access to the internet.
An IAM role is configured to be assumable by any entity, violating least privilege principles.
There is a direct chain from an internet-exposed security group to an assumable IAM role via STS:AssumeRole.
An overly permissive IAM policy grants access that can lead to public exposure of S3 resources.
